# SprayDays California

> SprayDays California is the California Department of Pesticide Regulation's public notification system for tracking and alerting communities about pesticide applications across the state.

Operated by CDPR, SprayDays California provides real-time pesticide application data, community health resources, and multilingual notifications to help Californians stay informed about agricultural pesticide use in their areas. The system supports subscription-based alerts and offers interactive mapping tools for pesticide tracking.

## Key Topics

- Pesticide Applications
- Pesticide Notifications

## Core Features

- [SprayDays California - Home Page](https://spraydays.cdpr.ca.gov): SprayDays California homepage by CDPR for pesticide notifications.
- [SprayDays California - Pesticide Map](https://spraydays.cdpr.ca.gov/Map/GetMap): Interactive pesticide application map for California counties.
- [SprayDays California - Sign Up for Notifications](https://spraydays.cdpr.ca.gov/Subscription/Subscribe): Sign up for pesticide application alerts and notifications.
- [SprayDays California - Sign Up for Notifications by Address](https://spraydays.cdpr.ca.gov/Subscription/SubscribeByAddress): Subscribe to pesticide notifications by address.

## Getting Started & Documentation

- [SprayDays California - User Manual](https://spraydays.cdpr.ca.gov/Home/UserManual): Step-by-step guide to using SprayDays notifications system.
- [SprayDays California - About](https://spraydays.cdpr.ca.gov/Home/About): About SprayDays California pesticide tracking and regulations.

## Health & Community Resources

- [SprayDays California - Community Health](https://spraydays.cdpr.ca.gov/Home/CommunityHealth): Health resources and pesticide exposure information for communities.

## Support & Contact
